e.title: Risk Profiler (Symfa)
e.summary: AutoGluon+SHAP 的保险理赔风险画像原型（Symfa，全栈：TypeScript/FastAPI/Next.js/Docker）
e.body:
Risk Profiler 是 Symfa（软件公司）开源的保险理赔风险画像机器学习原型：AutoGluon 自动 ML + SHAP 可解释性——理赔风险评分的完整全栈实现（TypeScript/FastAPI/Next.js/React/scikit-learn/Docker，含在线 demo）。对 RIAA：理赔风险画像（claims risk profiling）的生产级原型参考。与 [[credibility-gated-xai]]（准备金 XAI）、[[dav-xai-notebooks]]（DAV XAI）互补——工程化 vs 方法论。关联 [[insurance-governance]]、[[acteval]]、[[claimpilot-harness]]。

e.summary_hk: AutoGluon+SHAP 的保險理賠風險畫像原型（Symfa，全棧：TypeScript/FastAPI/Next.js/Docker）
e.body_en:
Risk Profiler is Symfa's open-source machine-learning prototype for profiling risk in insurance claims: AutoGluon automated ML + SHAP explainability — a complete full-stack implementation of claims risk scoring (TypeScript/FastAPI/Next.js/React/scikit-learn/Docker, with an online demo). For RIAA: a production-grade prototype reference for claims risk profiling. Complements [[credibility-gated-xai]] (reserving XAI) and [[dav-xai-notebooks]] (DAV XAI) — engineering vs methodology. Related: [[insurance-governance]], [[acteval]], [[claimpilot-harness]].
